description: Cota x Área x Volume dos Reservatórios de Usinas Hidrelétricas is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A Resolução Conjunta ANA/ANEEL nº 03/2010 estabelece que as Usinas Hidrelétricas despachadas centralizadamente pelo Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) ao completar 10 anos em operação comercial, devem realizar a avaliação do assoreamento dos seus reservatórios com a atualização das tabelas Cota x Área x Volume (CAV). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Usina Hidrelétrica, UHE, Resolução Conjunta ANA ANEEL 03/2010, Reservatório, Curvas Cota Area Volume. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
